item.title: Villanova University Elects 4 New Members To Board of Trustees
item.description: Villanova University announced it has elected four new members to its Board of Trustees, adding The Very Rev. Barnaby Johns, OSA, Kristin E. Reed, David K. “Duke” Reyes and Robert F. Tyson to the University’s 38-member governing board. The appointments took effect Jan. 1. The post Villanova University Elects 4 New Members To Board of Trustees appeared first on Pulse 2.0.

item.title: Applied Brain Research Raises Seed Round To Scale On-Device Voice AI With TSP1 Edge Chip
item.description: Applied Brain Research (ABR) announced it has closed an oversubscribed seed funding round to accelerate development and commercialization of its TSP1 “state space accelerator” chip and accompanying software models for edge AI inference. The round was led by Two Small Fish Ventures, and the firm’s general partner Eva Lau will join ABR’s board. The post Applied Brain Research Raises Seed Round To Scale On-Device Voice AI With TSP1 Edge Chip appeared first on Pulse 2.0.

item.title: Elevate Capital Invests $1.6 Million in 5 Oregon Startups Through State-Backed Venture Program
item.description: Elevate Capital announced it has deployed $1.6 million into five Oregon-based startups through the state’s Venture Direct program, a venture capital initiative supported by the federal State Small Business Credit Initiative (SSBCI). The firm said the investments are intended to expand access to early-stage capital for local founders and support long-term economic growth across Oregon. item.title: Polar Light Technologies: €5+ Million Raised To Push Pyramidal MicroLEDs Toward First Product Launches
item.description: Polar Light Technologies AB, a Linköping, Sweden-based semiconductor company developing MicroLED display technology, announced it has closed a €5 million-plus funding round to support commercialization and the rollout of its first products. The round was led by J2L Holding AB, with participation from STOAF, Almi Invest and Butterfly Ventures. item.description: Threadlock Precision, a U.S.-based network of precision manufacturing companies, has acquired Kremin Inc., a Michigan CNC machining business serving aerospace, defense and medical customers for more than 40 years. item.title: Inquis Medical: $75 Million Series C Raised To Expand AVENTUS Thrombectomy Commercial Rollout
item.description: Inquis Medical announced it closed a $75 million Series C financing to accelerate nationwide commercial expansion of its AVENTUS thrombectomy system and advance a next-generation product pipeline, as the company looks to scale adoption in venous thromboembolic disease (VTE). item.description: ProductPlan has acquired Winware.ai, an AI-native customer and market research platform, to add agentic and generative AI–powered decision intelligence to its product lifecycle management and roadmapping software. item.title: SilverAssist Acquires Caring.com To Expand National Senior Housing Referral Network
item.description: SilverAssist, a senior assistance network that connects families with information, guidance, and services for aging and senior living decisions, announced it has acquired Caring (Caring.com), adding one of the industry’s largest senior housing referral footprints to its platform and accelerating its national reach and operator connectivity. item.title: PulseAI: Seed Funding Secured To Advance AI-Driven ECG Diagnostics
item.description: PulseAI announced it has closed a seed funding round to expand deployment of its AI-enabled electrocardiogram (ECG) diagnostics platform and progress toward U.S. FDA 510(k) clearance, positioning the company to commercialize clinical decision-support tools for both primary care and acute care environments. item.title: Bansk Group Closes $1.45 Billion Fund II
item.description: Bansk Group, a New York-based consumer-focused private investment firm, said it has reached a final close on its second fund with $1.45 billion in total commitments, exceeding its $1 billion target. The firm said Fund II closed in December 2025 and drew strong participation from existing limited partners alongside a “diverse group” of new global investors.
